camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeFrontVulPatchList --region cn-hangzhou --Type sys --Lang zh --Info '[{"name":"5000803","uuid":"026c9296-1234-5678-b937-a7d81f05****","tag":"system"}]' --OperateType vul_fix
description_en: Queries the list of prerequisite patches that must be installed for a specified Windows system vulnerability
description_zh: 查询指定的Windows系统漏洞需要安装的前置补丁列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-front-vul-patch-list --info '[{"name":"5000803","uuid":"026c9296-1234-5678-b937-a7d81f05****","tag":"system"}]' --operate-type vul_fix --type sys --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFrontVulPatchList

parameters.help_en:
The information about the Windows system vulnerability to query. The value is a JSON string that contains the following fields:
name: the vulnerability name.
uuid: the UUID of the server that has the vulnerability.
tag: the vulnerability tag. Set this field to system, which indicates a system vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的Windows系统漏洞的信息。使用JSON格式的字符串表示，包含以下字段：
name：漏洞名称。
uuid：存在漏洞的服务器UUID。
tag：漏洞标签。固定取值为system，表示系统漏洞
parameters.name: info

parameters.help_en: The method to handle the vulnerability. Set this parameter to vul_fix, which indicates fixing the vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞的处理方式。固定取值：vul_fix，表示修复漏洞
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en: The type of vulnerability to query. Set this parameter to sys, which indicates a Windows vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的漏洞类型。固定取值：sys，表示Windows漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang
